notes: All three written from SAP's own CVE records and patch day page plus finder (Onapsis) or RedRays readings of the notes. No page carried instructions to the agent. RedRays' SAML2 page included a network probe path; it was not copied. Priority set to urgent (not known exploited, no public exploit code). Exposure for the Gateway flaw set to internal because gateways should not face the internet, though some do.
